{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Wages of Phy'r''''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krann]]. It was located on a shopping concourse where an [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] criminal offered [[Spice/Legends|spice]] for sale, including the dangerous [[eldratz]]. The bar's primary clientele were [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and shopworkers. Table service was offered by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="FKM">{{WEGCite|story=For a Few Kilotons More|book=Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)}}</ref>
